title_en: Supplementary Provisions (VII) of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Implementation of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China for the Determination of Charges

articles.content_en:
Pursuant to the Amendment (X) to the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the "Amendment (X) to the Criminal Law") and the Amendment (XI) to the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the "Amendment (XI) to the Criminal Law"), and in light of the circumstances reflected in judicial practice, the following supplements and amendments are hereby made to the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Determination of Crimes under the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China and the Opinion of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Application of Crimes under the Specific Provisions of the Criminal Law:
These Provisions shall come into force on March 1, 2021.
